lessons.title: E2E Test Suite Setup with Playwright
lessons.description: Playwright automates real browsers to test your application end-to-end — from click to network to assertion.

sections.heading: What is Playwright?
paragraphs: Playwright is a browser automation framework that tests your application in real browsers. It simulates user interactions and verifies the complete user experience.
list: Auto-waits for elements — no manual waits or sleeps

codeExamples.heading: Playwright test setup
explanation: expect() with page matchers verifies the state.
Auto-waiting means Playwright waits for elements before interacting.

practice.task: Write a Playwright test that navigates to a page, fills a form and submits it. Verify the result appears on the page.

keyTakeaways: Playwright tests run in real browsers — testing the complete user experience.
Auto-waiting eliminates flaky tests from timing issues.
Use page methods for navigation, interaction and assertions.
Tests run headless in CI and headed for debugging.

lessons.title: Integrating E2E Automation into CI/CD Pipelines
lessons.description: Run Playwright tests automatically in your CI/CD pipeline — catch regressions before they reach production.

sections.heading: CI/CD integration
list: Playwright runs in headless mode in CI environments
Install browsers in CI with npx playwright install --with-deps
Generate HTML reports for test results
Parallel execution for faster CI runs

codeExamples.heading: GitHub Actions CI setup
codeExamples.code:
name: E2E Tests
on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm run test:e2e
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
explanation: GitHub Actions runs Playwright tests on every push and PR.
install --with-deps installs browser binaries in CI.
Upload the HTML report as an artifact for debugging failures.
Tests run headless by default — no display needed.

practice.task: Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs Playwright tests on every push.
hints: Use actions/checkout, setup-node and playwright install.
Run npx playwright test as the test step.

keyTakeaways: Playwright runs headless in CI — no display server needed.
Always install browsers with --with-deps in CI.
Upload test reports as artifacts for debugging failures.
Run E2E tests on every push and PR to catch regressions early.
lessons.challenge: Set up a complete CI pipeline with unit tests, linting and E2E tests running in parallel.
